label: 全栈框架与应用骨架
def: 一个项目里同时覆盖客户端与服务端的框架、站点生成器、脚手架、现成的应用底座，以及可自行部署的大型开源全栈应用
def_en: Frameworks, site generators, scaffolds, and application foundations that cover both client and server, plus large self-deployable open-source full-stack applications

subs.label: 全栈与元框架
subs.def: 自带路由、渲染、数据加载与服务端能力的全栈框架（Next.js、Nuxt、Remix、Rails、Laravel、Django、Phoenix 一类）
subs.def_en: Frameworks with built-in routing, rendering, data loading, and server capabilities (Next.js, Nuxt, Remix, Rails, Laravel, Django, Phoenix)

subs.label: 静态站点与文档发布
subs.def: 以内容发布为核心的静态站点与文档站框架、运行时渲染器及主题（Hugo、Jekyll、Docusaurus、docsify、MkDocs Material 一类）；通用交互式应用框架归「全栈与元框架」
subs.def_en: Content-focused static-site and documentation frameworks, runtime renderers, and themes such as Hugo, Jekyll, Docusaurus, docsify, and MkDocs Material; general interactive application frameworks belong in Full-stack & Meta-frameworks

subs.label: 脚手架与项目模板
subs.def: SaaS 模板、全栈起步项目、示例应用和最佳实践参考实现，以及 .gitignore 等项目配置模板
subs.def_en: SaaS templates, full-stack starter projects, sample apps, and reference implementations, plus project configuration templates such as .gitignore files

subs.label: 管理后台与低代码
subs.def: 后台管理模板、内部工具、低代码 / 无代码应用构建平台与工作流搭建工具
subs.def_en: Admin templates, internal tools, and low-code / no-code app and workflow builders

subs.label: CMS 与电商平台
subs.def: 无头 CMS、博客 / 建站系统与无头电商平台（Strapi、Ghost、Payload、Directus、Medusa、Saleor 一类）
subs.def_en: Headless CMS, blogging and site-building systems, and headless commerce platforms (Strapi, Ghost, Payload, Directus, Medusa, Saleor)

subs.label: 协作、沟通与社区应用
subs.def: 可自行部署的团队协作、笔记与知识库、项目管理、即时通讯、视频会议、录屏分享、协同设计和社区应用；个人云、文件同步和设备服务归「个人云与自托管服务」
subs.def_en: Self-hostable collaboration, notes and knowledge bases, project management, messaging, video meetings, screen sharing, collaborative design, and community apps; personal cloud, file sync, and device services belong in Personal Cloud & Self-hosted Services

subs.label: 业务系统与个人效率应用
subs.def: 可自行部署的 CRM、ERP、支付、日程、邮件营销、链接管理与个人财务、简历等业务和效率类应用（Odoo、ERPNext、Twenty、Cal.com、Firefly III 一类）
subs.def_en: Self-deployable CRM, ERP, payments, scheduling, email marketing, link management, personal finance, and resume apps (Odoo, ERPNext, Twenty, Cal.com, Firefly III)

subs.label: 个人云与自托管服务
subs.def: 可自行部署的个人云、文件 / 照片 / 媒体管理、DNS 过滤、文件同步、远程桌面、搜索、仪表盘、智能家居与物联网服务；以团队沟通与共创为核心的应用归「协作、沟通与社区应用」
subs.def_en: Self-hostable personal cloud, file/photo/media management, DNS filtering, file sync, remote desktop, search, dashboards, smart-home, and IoT services; team communication and co-creation apps belong in Collaboration & Community Apps

label: 客户端与应用框架
def: 用户直接接触的一层：网页、移动端、桌面端与小程序的应用框架
def_en: The layer users touch directly: application frameworks for web, mobile, desktop, and mini-programs

subs.label: 前端视图框架
subs.def: React、Vue、Angular、Svelte、Solid 等视图框架，以及 jQuery、htmx、Alpine 一类的轻量方案
subs.def_en: View frameworks such as React, Vue, Angular, Svelte, and Solid, plus lightweight options like jQuery, htmx, and Alpine

subs.label: 状态、路由与数据请求
subs.def: 状态管理、路由、数据请求与缓存、表单和 Hooks 工具库（Redux、Zustand、React Router、TanStack Query、Axios 一类）
subs.def_en: State management, routing, data fetching and caching, forms, and hook utility libraries (Redux, Zustand, React Router, TanStack Query, Axios)

subs.label: 移动与跨端应用框架
subs.def: Android / iOS 开发框架、Flutter、React Native、Expo、Ionic 与小程序跨端框架
subs.def_en: Android and iOS development frameworks, Flutter, React Native, Expo, Ionic, and mini-program cross-platform frameworks

subs.label: 桌面应用框架
subs.def: Electron、Tauri、Wails 一类的桌面应用框架，以及 Rust / Go / C# 的原生 GUI 工具包
subs.def_en: Desktop frameworks such as Electron, Tauri, and Wails, and native GUI toolkits for Rust, Go, and C#

label: 界面组件与视觉
def: 搭建界面用的现成组件与图形库：组件库、动效、图表与图形、编辑器、交互小组件和媒体组件
def_en: Ready-made components and graphics libraries for building interfaces: component kits, motion, charts and graphics, editors, interactive widgets, and media components

subs.label: 组件库与 CSS 框架
subs.def: 组件库、设计系统和 CSS / 样式框架（shadcn/ui、Ant Design、Bootstrap、Tailwind 一类）
subs.def_en: Component libraries, design systems, and CSS and styling frameworks (shadcn/ui, Ant Design, Bootstrap, Tailwind)

subs.label: 图标、字体与主题
subs.def: 图标集与图标字体（Font Awesome、Lucide 一类）、编程字体（Fira Code、Nerd Fonts、Iosevka 一类），以及 Dracula 这类跨应用的配色主题
subs.def_en: Icon sets and icon fonts (Font Awesome, Lucide), programming fonts (Fira Code, Nerd Fonts, Iosevka), and cross-application color themes such as Dracula

subs.label: 交互小组件
subs.def: 轮播、拖拽、上传、表格、虚拟列表、引导提示、弹层与下拉等单点交互组件
subs.def_en: Single-purpose interactive widgets: carousels, drag and drop, uploads, tables, virtual lists, tours, popovers, and dropdowns

subs.label: 动画与动效
subs.def: CSS / JS 动画库、滚动动效、Lottie 一类的矢量动画渲染
subs.def_en: CSS and JS animation libraries, scroll effects, and vector animation rendering such as Lottie

subs.label: 编辑器与富文本
subs.def: 嵌入网页 / 应用的代码编辑器组件、富文本编辑框架和语法高亮（独立的编辑器与 IDE 归「编程语言与开发环境」）
subs.def_en: Code-editor components, rich-text editing frameworks, and syntax highlighting for embedding in web pages and apps (standalone editors and IDEs belong under Languages & Dev Environment)

subs.label: 图表与地图
subs.def: 图表、地图和数据可视化库（D3、ECharts、Chart.js、Leaflet、Matplotlib、Dash 一类）
subs.def_en: Chart, map, and data-visualization libraries (D3, ECharts, Chart.js, Leaflet, Matplotlib, Dash)

subs.label: 图形、游戏引擎与白板
subs.def: 2D / 3D 渲染与游戏引擎、Canvas 库、程序化图形生成、图像 / CAD 编辑、白板、图表及协同设计工具；音视频工具归「媒体、文档与演示」
subs.def_en: 2D/3D rendering and game engines, Canvas libraries, procedural graphics, image and CAD editors, whiteboards, diagrams, and collaborative design tools; audio/video tools belong in Media, Documents & Presentations

subs.label: 媒体、文档与演示
subs.def: 音视频采集、播放、录制、剪辑、转码与流媒体服务，图像压缩、文档排版、数学动画、PDF 渲染和幻灯片演示的工具与框架
subs.def_en: Tools and frameworks for audio/video capture, playback, recording, editing, transcoding, and streaming; image compression, document typesetting, mathematical animation, PDF rendering, and slides

label: 工程化工具链
def: 项目层面的构建、检查、测试与依赖管理工具
def_en: Project-level tools for building, checking, testing, and managing dependencies

subs.label: 构建、打包与编译
subs.def: 打包器、转译器、编译器与构建工具（Vite、webpack、Babel、esbuild、SWC、Rollup 一类）
subs.def_en: Bundlers, transpilers, compilers, and build tools (Vite, webpack, Babel, esbuild, SWC, Rollup)

subs.label: 代码规范与格式化
subs.def: Lint、格式化工具与 JavaScript / Python 的代码风格规范（ESLint、Prettier、Ruff、Black、Biome 一类）
subs.def_en: Linters, formatters, and JavaScript / Python code-style standards (ESLint, Prettier, Ruff, Black, Biome)

subs.label: 测试与性能
subs.def: 单元 / 端到端测试、浏览器自动化、压测、网页性能审计、应用安全漏洞扫描，以及网站配置与攻击面诊断；以利用漏洞或入侵为主要用途的工具不属于此类
subs.def_en: Unit and end-to-end tests, browser automation, load tests, web performance audits, application vulnerability scanning, and website-configuration or attack-surface diagnostics; tools primarily for exploitation or intrusion are out of scope

subs.label: 包管理与版本管理
subs.def: 跨语言和特定语言的包管理器、开发工具版本管理器与依赖管理，包括 Homebrew、Nix、vcpkg 等系统或 C/C++ 包管理器
subs.def_en: Cross-language and language-specific package managers, developer-tool version managers, and dependency managers, including system and C/C++ tools such as Homebrew, Nix, and vcpkg

subs.label: 开发辅助、调试与逆向
subs.def: 开发者门户、Monorepo 与组件开发环境、Git 钩子、热重载、调试器、逆向工程和开发者在线工具箱；通用 CLI 归「命令行工具」
subs.def_en: Developer portals, monorepo and component development environments, Git hooks, hot reload, debuggers, reverse-engineering tools, and online developer toolboxes; general CLI tools belong in Command-line Tools

label: 编程语言与开发环境
def: 开发者每天直接使用的东西：编程语言与编译器基础设施、代码编辑器、命令行与终端，以及构建命令行应用的框架
def_en: What developers use directly every day: programming languages and compiler infrastructure, code editors, the command line and terminal, and frameworks for building command-line apps

subs.label: 编程语言、运行时与编译器
subs.def: 通用与领域专用编程语言、解释器、运行时和编译器，包括数值计算领域的并行语言与 JIT 编译器
subs.def_en: General-purpose and domain-specific programming languages, interpreters, runtimes, and compilers, including parallel languages and JIT compilers for numerical computing

subs.label: 代码编辑器与 IDE
subs.def: 开发者日常使用的独立代码编辑器、IDE 和远程开发环境（VS Code、Vim / Neovim、Zed、Helix 一类），以及 Vim / Neovim / Emacs 的发行版、配置与插件管理；嵌入网页的编辑器组件归「编辑器与富文本」
subs.def_en: Standalone code editors, IDEs, and remote development environments developers use daily (VS Code, Vim / Neovim, Zed, Helix), plus Vim, Neovim, and Emacs distributions, configurations, and plugin managers; editor components embedded in web pages belong under Editors & Rich Text

subs.label: Shell 与终端
subs.def: Shell、终端模拟器与复用器、提示符、插件、补全、dotfiles 配置，以及提供 Linux 命令行环境的兼容层
subs.def_en: Shells, terminal emulators and multiplexers, prompts, plugins, completions, dotfiles, and compatibility layers providing a Linux command-line environment

subs.label: Git 与版本控制工具
subs.def: Git 本体、其他版本控制系统，以及 Git 图形与终端客户端、差异查看和分支工作流工具（Git、Jujutsu、Lazygit、Delta 一类）
subs.def_en: Git itself, other version control systems, and Git terminal clients, diff viewers, and branching-workflow tools (Git, Jujutsu, Lazygit, Delta)

subs.label: 命令行工具
subs.def: curl 等命令行基础工具，以及 fzf、ripgrep、jq、bat 一类的现代命令行工具、文件管理器、系统监控与基准测试工具
subs.def_en: Core command-line tools such as curl, plus modern CLI tools like fzf, ripgrep, jq, and bat, file managers, system monitors, and benchmarking tools

subs.label: CLI 与 TUI 框架
subs.def: 用来构建命令行与终端界面应用的框架和库：参数解析、终端样式、进度条与 TUI 组件（Cobra、Bubble Tea、Ratatui、Ink、Textual、Rich 一类）
subs.def_en: Frameworks and libraries for building command-line and terminal UI applications: argument parsing, terminal styling, progress bars, and TUI components (Cobra, Bubble Tea, Ratatui, Ink, Textual, Rich)

label: 后端与服务框架
def: 服务端框架、微服务治理、API 层、认证与后端即服务
def_en: Server-side frameworks, microservice governance, API layers, authentication, and back-end-as-a-service

subs.label: 后端框架
subs.def: Express、FastAPI、Spring Boot、Gin、NestJS 等服务端 Web 框架与网络应用框架
subs.def_en: Server-side web and network-application frameworks such as Express, FastAPI, Spring Boot, Gin, and NestJS

subs.label: 微服务与服务治理
subs.def: 微服务与 RPC 框架、服务发现、配置中心、熔断限流、分布式事务、任务调度与分布式服务运行时（Dubbo、Go Zero、Dapr、Nacos、Sentinel、etcd 一类）
subs.def_en: Microservice and RPC frameworks, service discovery, configuration centers, circuit breaking and rate limiting, distributed transactions, job scheduling, and distributed service runtimes (Dubbo, Go Zero, Dapr, Nacos, Sentinel, etcd)

subs.label: API 与网关
subs.def: API 设计、请求调试、文档、GraphQL / tRPC / gRPC、网关与代理框架、实时通信；开发调试用的 HTTP 拦截代理归此类，专门用于攻击的工具不收录
subs.def_en: API design, request debugging, and documentation, GraphQL / tRPC / gRPC, gateways and proxy frameworks, and real-time communication; HTTP intercepting proxies used for development belong here, while attack-focused tools are out of scope

subs.label: 认证、身份与密钥
subs.def: 登录、SSO、身份管理、权限控制、特权访问与凭据加密管理工具
subs.def_en: Login, SSO, identity management, access control, privileged access, and credential encryption or management tools

subs.label: 后端即服务
subs.def: 开箱即用的后端服务（认证、数据库、存储、实时），Supabase、Appwrite 一类
subs.def_en: Ready-made back-end services (auth, database, storage, real time) such as Supabase and Appwrite

label: 数据与中间件
def: 应用背后的数据库、ORM、缓存、搜索、消息、网页数据采集、数据处理与分析
def_en: Databases, ORMs, caching, search, messaging, web data collection, processing, and analytics behind applications

subs.label: 数据库引擎
subs.def: 关系型、文档型、时序、分析型（OLAP）、嵌入式与键值存储引擎
subs.def_en: Relational, document, time-series, analytical (OLAP), embedded, and key-value storage engines

subs.label: ORM 与数据库工具
subs.def: ORM / 查询构建器、数据库客户端与建模工具
subs.def_en: ORMs, query builders, database clients, and modeling tools

subs.label: 缓存、搜索与对象存储
subs.def: 缓存与内存数据库、搜索引擎和对象存储（Redis、Elasticsearch、MinIO、Meilisearch 一类）
subs.def_en: Caches and in-memory databases, search engines, and object storage (Redis, Elasticsearch, MinIO, Meilisearch)

subs.label: 消息与任务队列
subs.def: 消息队列、事件流、后台任务队列与通知基础设施（Kafka、RocketMQ、Celery 一类）
subs.def_en: Message queues, event streaming, background task queues, and notification infrastructure (Kafka, RocketMQ, Celery)

subs.label: 数据处理与工作流编排
subs.def: 流 / 批处理、ETL、数据同步、外部数据源接入（含金融数据 API）、DataFrame 引擎，以及工作流与任务编排引擎
subs.def_en: Stream/batch processing, ETL, data sync, external data-source connectors (including financial data APIs), DataFrame engines, and workflow/task orchestration

subs.label: 数据分析、BI 与产品分析
subs.def: 可自托管的 BI 与数据分析平台，以及网站与产品分析工具（Superset、Metabase、PostHog、Plausible 一类）
subs.def_en: Self-hostable BI and data-analysis platforms, and website and product analytics tools (Superset, Metabase, PostHog, Plausible)

subs.label: 网页抓取与数据采集
subs.def: 通用网页与社交平台抓取框架、可视化爬虫和代理池；以生成 LLM 可用上下文为核心的专用工具归 AI「网页抓取」
subs.def_en: General web and social scraping frameworks, visual crawlers, and proxy pools; tools centered on model-ready context belong in AI Web Crawling

label: 通用库与 SDK
def: 按语言生态归类的通用工具库和客户端库
def_en: General-purpose utility and client libraries grouped by language ecosystem

subs.label: JS / TS 通用库
subs.def: 日期、校验、数据处理、文档与图片处理、HTTP 与响应式等 JavaScript / TypeScript 库
subs.def_en: JavaScript / TypeScript libraries for dates, validation, data handling, document and image processing, HTTP, and reactive programming

subs.label: JVM / Android 通用库
subs.def: Java、Kotlin 与 Android 的工具库、网络库与图片加载库
subs.def_en: Utility, networking, and image-loading libraries for Java, Kotlin, and Android

subs.label: Python / Go / Swift / PHP 通用库
subs.def: 其他语言生态的 HTTP 客户端、日志、配置与校验库
subs.def_en: HTTP clients, logging, configuration, and validation libraries from other language ecosystems

subs.label: C / C++ 通用库
subs.def: C / C++ 生态的通用基础库，覆盖 JSON、格式化、日志、测试、异步 I/O、压缩与密码学；包管理器归「包管理与版本管理」
subs.def_en: General C/C++ libraries for JSON, formatting, logging, testing, asynchronous I/O, compression, and cryptography; package managers belong in Package & Version Management

label: 部署与运维
def: 把应用发布上线、跑起来并保持健康
def_en: Getting an application shipped, running, and healthy

subs.label: 容器与运行时
subs.def: 容器引擎、容器运行时、Compose、镜像工具与容器管理界面（Docker、Podman、Portainer 一类）
subs.def_en: Container engines and runtimes, Compose, image tooling, and container management UIs (Docker, Podman, Portainer)

subs.label: Kubernetes 与集群管理
subs.def: Kubernetes 及其发行版、本地集群、服务网格、包管理、镜像仓库与集群管理工具（Kubernetes、K3s、Istio、Helm、K9s 一类）
subs.def_en: Kubernetes and its distributions, local clusters, service meshes, package management, registries, and cluster management tools (Kubernetes, K3s, Istio, Helm, K9s)

subs.label: 基础设施即代码
subs.def: 用代码声明和管理基础设施与环境（Terraform、OpenTofu、Pulumi、Ansible、Vagrant）
subs.def_en: Declaring and managing infrastructure and environments as code (Terraform, OpenTofu, Pulumi, Ansible, Vagrant)

subs.label: 部署与自托管平台
subs.def: 自托管 PaaS、部署面板、Serverless 框架、进程管理与本地云模拟
subs.def_en: Self-hosted PaaS, deployment panels, serverless frameworks, process managers, and local cloud emulation

subs.label: 反向代理、证书与隧道
subs.def: 面向应用发布和远程开发的 Web 服务器、反向代理、Web 应用防火墙、HTTPS 证书自动化及内网开发隧道；通用翻墙客户端与 VPN 不属于此类
subs.def_en: Web servers, reverse proxies, web application firewalls, HTTPS certificate automation, and development tunnels for deploying or accessing apps; general circumvention clients and VPNs are out of scope

subs.label: CI/CD 与自动化
subs.def: 持续集成 / 交付、发布自动化、依赖更新，以及带 CI 能力的自托管 Git 代码托管平台
subs.def_en: Continuous integration and delivery, release automation, dependency updates, and self-hosted Git hosting platforms with built-in CI

subs.label: 监控与可观测
subs.def: 指标、日志、链路追踪、错误追踪、应用监控与性能诊断
subs.def_en: Metrics, logs, distributed tracing, error tracking, application monitoring, and performance diagnostics

label: 学习与教程
def: 路线图、课程、语言教程与底层原理的学习资料
def_en: Roadmaps, courses, language tutorials, and learning material on how things work underneath

subs.label: 路线图与综合课程
subs.def: 开发者路线图、综合课程、编程书单、CS 自学路线、大学课程清单、论文阅读、项目创意与实战项目合集
subs.def_en: Developer roadmaps, comprehensive courses, programming book lists, CS self-study paths, university course lists, paper reading, project ideas, and hands-on project collections

subs.label: 前端、JavaScript 与移动教程
subs.def: JavaScript、TypeScript、React、CSS、HTML 与 Android / Flutter 的教程、速查表、练习、周刊与知识体系
subs.def_en: Tutorials, cheat sheets, exercises, weeklies, and knowledge bases for JavaScript, TypeScript, React, CSS, HTML, and Android and Flutter

subs.label: 编程语言教程
subs.def: Python、Go、Rust、C++、Java 等语言的教程、速查表、练习和「陷阱」合集，以及正则表达式等通用语言技能
subs.def_en: Tutorials, cheat sheets, exercises, and gotcha collections for languages such as Python, Go, Rust, C++, and Java, plus general skills such as regular expressions

subs.label: 命令行、Git 与运维实践
subs.def: 命令行、Git、Docker、Kubernetes、DevOps 与云服务的教程、速查表和练习
subs.def_en: Tutorials, cheat sheets, and exercises for the command line, Git, Docker, Kubernetes, DevOps, and cloud services

subs.label: 操作系统与编译原理
subs.def: 操作系统内核、从零写操作系统、编译器与小型系统实现的源码解读和教程
subs.def_en: Source-code walkthroughs and tutorials on operating-system kernels, writing an OS from scratch, compilers, and small system implementations

subs.label: 算法与数据结构
subs.def: 算法与数据结构的多语言实现、刷题题解与攻略、可视化和学习路线
subs.def_en: Multi-language algorithm and data-structure implementations, LeetCode solutions and guides, visualizers, and study paths

label: 面试、规范与清单
def: 面试与系统设计指南、编码规范与最佳实践、精选清单
def_en: Interview and system-design guides, coding standards and best practices, and curated lists

subs.label: 系统设计与面试
subs.def: 系统设计、分布式、编码面试和前后端岗位的面试指南（不含纯算法题库，那类归「算法与数据结构」）
subs.def_en: System design, distributed systems, coding-interview, and front-end / back-end interview guides (pure algorithm collections belong under Algorithms & Data Structures)

subs.label: 最佳实践与规范
subs.def: 编码规范、设计模式、API 指南、项目结构与工程实践清单
subs.def_en: Coding standards, design patterns, API guidelines, project structure, and engineering-practice checklists

subs.label: 前端与移动精选清单
subs.def: 围绕前端框架、组件、移动端与桌面端技术栈的 Awesome 列表和资源导航
subs.def_en: Awesome lists and resource directories around front-end frameworks, components, and mobile and desktop stacks

subs.label: 语言、后端与通用精选清单
subs.def: 围绕编程语言、后端、运维、自托管、命令行、自动化工作流模板和开源项目发现的资源清单；针对前端与移动生态的清单归「前端与移动精选清单」
subs.def_en: Resource lists for programming languages, back ends, operations, self-hosting, command lines, automation workflow templates, and open-source discovery; front-end and mobile lists belong in Front-end & Mobile Lists
